tests.scope: Pure synthetic word/sample clocks; actual current authored text and font-only formatter validation. No actual prepare/profile/model/media/resource calls.
coverage: Exact literal alignment reproduces the synthetic particle boundary failure.
Audited whole-word start/end edges rescue only explicitly listed source offsets; exact literal boundaries take precedence.
Merged ASR words keep internal canonical spacing boundaries Pending until an authored cue reflow.
Current context, raw WAV/PCM/format, cache, complete canonical/recognized literals and exact observed word records are required.
Timestamp/sample/index/type tampering, overlap, reversal, internal endpoints and unsupported partial words are rejected.
Aliases, recognition modification, prompt use, automatic speech approval and human/listening approval are rejected.
Complete 14-paragraph/48-take/43-group/98-KO/86-EN display build with synthetic clocks passes and retains line-local emphasis.
Complete display build stays Pending on an unsupported particle boundary and succeeds only with explicit current synthetic word-edge evidence, retaining raw differences.
Immutable and published voice receipts may differ only outside the explicitly checked raw/profile/repair/engine fields.
No implicit write or auto-hashed evidence path acceptance.

publicApi.prepare: prepare(asr_review=None, voice_evidence=None, alignment_evidence=None) -> {ready,fingerprint,output,timing,voice,asr}; raises Pending until actual current inputs and every requested boundary are supported.
publicApi.verifyExisting: verify_existing(path) -> {timing,voice,asr}; freshly reconstructs current timing and compares exact JSON and plain SRT bytes without writes.
publicApi.verifiedAsrReview: verified_asr_review(path) validates only the actual existing current repaired ASR review/cache through the pinned V6 adapter.
publicApi.voiceBinding: voice_binding(voice,review,narration) keeps full raw/profile/repair/PCM/sample-clock checks; only the independently validated repairSelection extends the approved identity.
publicApi.literalResolver: resolve_literal_interval(timing,paragraph,exactUniqueKoPhrase) uses verified canonical word edges and exposes their actual boundary provenance.
publicApi.evidenceValidator: validate_evidence(document,context,sentences,takes,result_pins) is pure; apply_evidence adds only missing audited whole-word endpoints.
publicApi.write: Only explicit --write calls immutable output writing after a fresh exact reconstruction. Default does not write or launch jobs.

wordEdgeEvidenceContract.selection: Caller supplies an explicit current-project or current-media path AND SHA256; the adapter never discovers or auto-trusts a sidecar.
wordEdgeEvidenceContract.boundaryMapping: Explicit canonicalOffset plus actualEdge=start or end; derives only the first selected whole word's startSample or last selected whole word's endSample.
wordEdgeEvidenceContract.spacing: Only equivalent source whitespace immediately adjacent to the complete canonical interval may share its outer edge. No internal merged-word or fractional clock is created.
wordEdgeEvidenceContract.unresolved: Any unsupported requested boundary remains Pending; author a source-exact cue reflow that keeps the complete observed word together if needed.
wordEdgeEvidenceContract.rawDifferences: Canonical and recognized literals, character differences, source word indices and original unsupported boundaries remain available. Display alignment is not a speech-quality pass.

actualReadiness.rendererBinding: Parked until actual repaired voice, ASR, timing and accepted mix are bound.

preservation: Old caption V4/V5 helpers, original recognition, all voice inputs/PCM/proofs, authored source JSON, checkpoints and shared metadata were not changed by this source-only task.
